In fact, over the last 24 hours, we've seen $304 million worth of shorts liquidated. We did get some longs liquidated over the last 12 hours as we've kind of come down from those highs, which isn't really surprising. And I'll get to leverage more in just a moment here. And so now it's just a question of are things going to calm down or will they once again escalate? We've obviously discussed that before is reacting we're going to see how u.s stock futures are reacting we've obviously discussed that before on what's probably going to take place there so just be aware of that now that being said i did want to mention that leverage is stacking up in a big way again the market is betting very heavily that we're going to see some downside right now we actually have a 13 imbalance to the short side in terms of ADA. And this is a similar trend throughout the crypto market. We're watching open interest slightly up. We're watching short positions opened up, trying to push the crypto market down. Just to show you guys, this is the liquidation heat map here for ADA. You guys can see some long leverage stacked up down here at just below 26 cents. So if we do start making some downside moves, understand that we could potentially be moving lower in terms of ADA, maybe down towards the bottom of this, you know, the this much longer-term trend we were building here, which is down towards like $0.25.
